entities.name: José Edvar Simões
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Edvar Simões, also commonly known as Edvar Simões, born 23 April 1943, is a former Brazilian professional basketball player and coach. Simões participated at the 1967 and 1970 FIBA World Championships with the Brazil national basketball team. He won a bronze medal at the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.
